item.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians in the West Bank, setting fires and smashing cars
item.summary: Israeli settlers rampaged through multiple Palestinian villages overnight Saturday and into Sunday, smashing cars, setting fires and wounding several men in the latest flare-up of violence in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Iranian Kurdish fighters find themselves in the middle of U.S.-Iran war as they wait in Iraq
item.summary: Despite the attacks on Iranian Kurdish camps in Iraq, there remains a waiting game for Iranian Kurds hoping to play a part in regime change across the border.

item.title: As Middle Eastern countries struggle to down Iranian drones, Ukraine sends 200 specialists to help
item.summary: After Iranian Shahed drones hit an oil refinery in Kuwait, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that Kyiv has sent more than 200 military specialists to the Middle East to help defend critical infrastructure from the same type of threat Ukraine has faced for years.

item.title: Palestinian man says Israeli settlers sexually assaulted him in front of his family
item.summary: Israeli settlers sexually assaulted a Palestinian man — tying his genitalia with zip ties and parading him naked in front of his family — during a mid-March attack in the occupied West Bank, according to the victim and eyewitnesses.

item.title: Netflix, Warner Music sign multi-year deal to produce artist documentaries
item.summary: Netflix ​and Warner Music Group have signed an exclusive multi-year deal to produce documentary series and films exploring the lives, music and legacies of the label's storied artist ‌roster.

item.title: Enjoy fleeing bloodhounds? England has the sport for you
item.summary: As the U.K. government cracks down on trail hunting, enthusiasts have come up with an ethical alternative with a modern twist. For The National, CBC’s Briar Stewart laces up to try clean boot hunting — the latest iteration of a historical English pastime.

Thousands urged to evacuate as Hawaii flooding anticipated to cause widespread damage
item.summary: As Hawaii endures its worst flooding in more than 20 years, officials are urging people in hard-hit areas to "LEAVE NOW." The warning early Saturday came after heavy rains fell on soil already saturated by downpours from a winter storm a week ago. Still more rain was expected ...

item.title: Iran women's soccer team greeted with a welcome ceremony in Tehran
item.summary: The Iranian women's soccer team crossed the Turkish border into Iran on Wednesday to complete a fraught return journey from Australia, after five members withdrew asylum claims they had lodged ‌there.

item.title: Cubans say every day is a struggle for survival as they face blackouts, water and fuel shortages
item.summary: Blackouts have been common for years, but now, since U.S. President Donald Trump imposed an oil blockade on Cuba in hopes of forcing the country’s collapse, the interruptions have become more frequent, longer, sometimes engulfing the whole country.
